title: DabAI job (input)
description: One video in. Validated by scripts/job/dabai_job.py validate(); unknown fields are rejected. v1 jobs (scripts/r13/dabai_job.py) are valid.

job_id.description: Names the outputs. HTTP: generated when missing. CLI: the input file stem.

input.description: A local file path (any ffmpeg-readable video with an audio track) or an http(s) URL (e.g. a presigned R2 GET URL; downloaded into out_dir/input/, its query string is never logged).

out_dir.description: CLI only: where the job writes everything. HTTP: set by the service ($DABAI_JOBS_DIR/<job_id>).

source_lang.description: auto = Whisper detects it (RU is the validated source). A given code that differs from the detected one adds the warning W_SOURCE_LANG.

target_lang.description: A Chatterbox language id from scripts/r13/lang_routes.json (22 languages; quality group per language in LANGS.md). en = the accepted RU->EN path.

polyglot.description: Per-sentence target languages in one video (scripts/r13/polyglot.py): {"mode": "units", "units": {"0": "de"}} | {"mode": "ranges", "ranges": [{"start": 0, "end": 20, "lang": "de"}]} | {"mode": "cycle", "langs": ["en", "de"]} | {"mode": "all", "lang": "de"}.

mode.description: quality = LatentSync 1.6 teacher, q2 + F3 composite + c8 overlapping windows (the eye-approved production stack). fast = the 4-step distilled student (r2 step 1500 EMA) + c8: ~-25..35 % face GPU, slightly weaker sync.

lipsync.description: off = voice-only dub, no face work.

lang.description: dub = the dubbed text timed on the dub; src = the original (Whisper word times).

image.description: PNG path on the worker; null = a rendered text mark.

bed.description: Background bed of the main video. auto = htdemucs when the NC bed is enabled on this worker, else Spleeter.

both_beds.description: List both bed variants in status.outputs (when produced).

keep_intermediate.description: false = the per-job work files (GBs) are deleted after the job; outputs, logs, status, metrics stay.

max_voices.description: TZ 6.3: more speakers than this -> one voice + warning W_MANY_SPEAKERS.

timeout_s.description: null = max(1800, 1200 x video minutes). Past it the job is killed: status TIMEOUT.

debug_env.description: Tests / research only: extra pipeline environment (fault injection). Never from the product.
